title: feat(spec)!: object-metric aggregate and trend take the shape the tile reads; drillDown, compareTo held for a ruling (#21464, stage 4)
body:
Part of #21464
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

## What this does

Stage 4 (S-metric) of the `ComponentPropsMap` `z.unknown()` close-out, per triage `5961300594`, the seat answers `5963787404` (staging A) and `5966636964` (the writer test: a writer is a value the renderer draws), and the claim `5970896052`. Of the metric tile's four `z.unknown()` members, **two are typed** and **two are held for a ruling**, because each one's by-reference candidate disagrees with what the tile reads. Read points are at the `.objectui-sha` pin `89cad75d55`, under `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/` unless named.

| `object-metric` member | was | now | read point |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `aggregate` | `z.unknown()` | strict `{ field?, function, groupBy? }` (module-private `ObjectMetricAggregateSchema`): `function` is the query AST's `AggregationFunction` by reference, `groupBy` is `ChartGroupBySchema` by reference and optional, and a function other than `count` needs a `field` | `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx:403-443` (`computeOne`: the request and the result column), `:405-427` (a structured `groupBy` goes to the spec-shape query; an absent one floors at `_all`), `:305` and `:344-353` (`function` picks the unit and the min / max width) |
| `trend` | `z.unknown()` | strict `{ value: number, label?: I18nLabel, direction?: 'up' \| 'down' \| 'neutral' }` (module-private `ObjectMetricTrendSchema`), the measured shape | `MetricWidget.tsx:437-450` draws `value` as a percentage and `direction` as the arrow; `:332-337` resolves `label`; the declared type is these three (`MetricWidget.tsx:242-246`, `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx:176-181`) |
| `drillDown` | `z.unknown()` | **held**, unchanged, docblock records the fork | `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx:602-651` reads `enabled`, `title`, `target`, `columns`, `maxRows` and `report`; `DrillDownDrawer.tsx:77-114` draws `report` as a report body |
| `compareTo` | `z.unknown()` | **held**, unchanged, docblock records the fork | `kind` alone, through `shiftFilterByCompareTo` and `compareToTrendLabelKey` (objectui `core/src/utils/compare-to.ts:99-137`), from `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx:468-469` and `:581` |

Neither typed member carries a default or a transform, so a parse returns the authored value byte for byte, and `ObjectMetricPropsParsed` still differs from the authored state on `filter` alone. `ObjectMetricProps` carries the two types instead of `unknown`. No new export: both schemas are module-private, as stage 2's lane and stage 3's `mobile` were.

## The by-reference candidates, measured member by member

The claim's mechanism assumption 2 named the chart's `aggregate` / `drillDown` and the dashboard widget's `compareTo` as the by-reference candidates. None of the three accept sets equals the tile's read:

| member | candidate | the tile reads it does not declare | it declares the tile does not read | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `aggregate` | `ChartAggregateSchema` | a `count_distinct` function (the chart's five leave it out; the tile forwards the engine's six, and objectui's unit-rule pin mounts one tile per `AggregationFunction` member, `__tests__/ObjectMetricWidget.countNotCurrency-10356.test.tsx:102-124`) | nothing, but it REQUIRES `groupBy`, and every authored showcase tile writes `{ field, function }` with none | not taken whole: it would refuse all thirteen showcase tiles. Its `groupBy` union is taken by reference, and `function` is the engine's own enum by reference |
| `trend` | none in the spec | — | — | typed to the read |
| `drillDown` | `ChartDrillDownSchema` | `report` (refused there, with guidance pointing at the metric; drawn here, `__tests__/objectMetricDrillDownMembers-8071.test.tsx:277-294`) | `filter` (objectui's own `ObjectMetricDrillDownConfig` refuses it by name; `__tests__/ObjectMetricWidget.drillDownRefusal-9002.test.tsx:56` authors one and parses under the chart's shape while the tile ignores it) | **fork, held** |
| `compareTo` | `DashboardWidgetSchema.shape.compareTo` | — | `dimension`, which this path never reads (`compare-to.ts:28-33`; `__tests__/ObjectMetricWidget.compareTo.test.tsx:105-115` pins it inert) | **fork, held** |

So `aggregate` is typed to the tile's read with its vocabulary by reference (one declaration per shape: the shape is the metric's, each member's vocabulary is declared once elsewhere), and the two members whose reference would declare a key the tile never reads are reported as forks rather than shipped. Both are put to the seat in the dev report's open questions.

## The census

A writer is a value written on an `object-metric`: a page-component node (an object literal naming the type, a literal annotated with the block's type, a direct parse through the row), the block's React component with the member as a prop or inside `schema={{…}}`, or the argument of a local test helper that mounts one. Values resolve through same-file constants; helper arguments and `it.each` rows were resolved by hand. The instrument is a TypeScript-AST walk over every `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.js`, `.jsx`, `.mjs`, `.json`, `.yaml`, `.md` and `.mdx` file, with fenced code in documents parsed too, plus a loose pass over every property or JSX attribute named for one of the four members in a file that names the block, triaged by hand. Each static value was parsed through the BUILT row.

| corpus | `aggregate` values · static (distinct) · parse · refused | `trend` | `drillDown` (held) | `compareTo` (held) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| objectstack `b610eabf72` (`examples/`, `packages/` with `packages/apps/`, `content/`, `skills/`, `apps/`) | 22 · 22 (4) · 21 · 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| objectui `89cad75d55` (whole tree) | 66 · 64 (19) · 63 · 1 | 12 · 12 (9) · 11 · 1 | 26 · 26 (14) | 5 · 5 (3) |

Re-checked at the final merge base `36ad3210d4`: the `.objectui-sha` pin is unchanged, and the commits `main` brought since `b610eabf72` add no line naming `object-metric` or `ObjectMetric` (0 hits in 5095 moved lines).

**objectstack writers.** The showcase's thirteen KPI tiles (`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/index.ts:75-78`, `my-work.page.ts:39-41`, the `kpi()` helper's six calls at `command-center.page.ts:147-152`), two YAML examples in `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx` (`:688`, `:1046`), and six test copies (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.test.ts:3479-3482`, `packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.test.ts:561`, `:565`): all `{ field, function }` with `count` or `sum`, all parse, all drawn. The one refused value is not a door of this row: `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md:160`'s `kind: 'html'` example writes `aggregate="count"`, which the html tier compiles against the component manifest, not through `ComponentPropsMap` (see Acceptance notes).

**objectui writers.** Every one is a test fixture, under `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/` unless named: the query, drill-down, trend and structured-groupBy member pins (`__tests__/objectMetricQueryMembers-8071`, `objectMetricDrillDownMembers-8071`, `objectMetricTrendMembers-8071`, `objectMetricStructuredGroupBy-8613`), the widget pins (`ObjectMetricWidget.*` and `ObjectMetric.*`), `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.refreshInPlace-10519.test.tsx:240`, and the two arms parsed through objectui's `ObjectMetricBlockSchema`, which takes this row by reference (`packages/types/src/__tests__/registered-type-arms-10859-b2.test.ts:149`, `:198`; `flat-props-refusal-10872.test.ts:160`). Under the writer test:

| writer | file:line at the pin | drawn or probe | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `aggregate: { field: 'amount', function: 'sum', groupBy: ['stage'] }` | `__tests__/objectMetricStructuredGroupBy-8613.test.tsx:225` | probe: the test's own title says an array is not the union's object arm, and the data adapter refuses it at the producer | refused, `invalid_union` at `aggregate.groupBy` — correct |
| `trend: { value: 12, direction: 'up', label, percent: 99, caption: 'Off-list caption' }` | `__tests__/objectMetricTrendMembers-8071.test.tsx:205` | probe: "reads no member the registration does not declare", asserting `99` and the caption are not drawn | refused, `unrecognized_keys` at `trend` — correct |
| `aggregate: { field: 'amount', function: 'count_distinct' }` (two `it.each` rows) | `__tests__/ObjectMetricWidget.countNotCurrency-10356.test.tsx:121`, `:127` | drawn: the tile shows the distinct count as a plain number | parses — this is why `function` is the engine's six, not the chart's five |
| every other `aggregate` and `trend` value (62 and 10) | the files above | drawn | parse |

The two values that are not static are the dashboard relays' run-time hand-offs (`DashboardRenderer.tsx:858`, `DashboardGridLayout.tsx:363`), which build a node from a dashboard widget's provider and pass through no parse.

## The held members (for the seat)

- **`drillDown`.** The chart's drill-down shape refuses the `report` the tile draws and declares the `filter` it ignores, so taking it by reference fails the writer test and declared = enforced at once. Typing it to the read needs a spec declaration of the drill `report` (objectui's structural `{ name, objectName, type?, columns, … } | { name }`, whose named arm `DrillDownDrawer` never draws), which is the S-objectui-held stage's definition.
- **`compareTo`.** Every measured writer parses under the dashboard widget's `{ kind, dimension? }`, so the reference refuses nothing; but it would declare a `dimension` the tile accepts and ignores. The alternative is the tile's projection, `{ kind }`, with `kind` by reference and `dimension` refused with a prescription.

Both stay `staged('object-metric', …)` in the enumeration pin, with the read each rests on, and the stage's text now says why.

## Changes

- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`: the two module-private schemas, the two typed members, the fork docblocks on the two held members, and an import of `ChartGroupBySchema` from `./chart.zod` (no import cycle: `chart.zod.ts` imports only `i18n`, `retired-key`, `strict-object` and `lazy-schema`).
- `packages/spec/src/ui/component-props-unknown-members.pin.test.ts`: the `aggregate` and `trend` lines leave the ledger; the `drillDown` and `compareTo` lines cite the corrected reads; the `object-metric` stage's text records the fork instead of the three by-reference candidates the census disproved.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/component-metric-family-typed-members.pin.test.ts` (new): §1 byte-identical parses of the drawn writers, §2 refusals by `code` and path, §3 the `function` and `groupBy` defs by identity, the restated count-needs-a-field rule held equal to the chart's over the chart's vocabulary, and `trend`'s three members, §4 the D3 registration.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-object-metric-aggregate-trend-typed.ts` (new) and `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` (the hand-written step-18 rationale fragment at order 69, the next free order once #21015's PR took 68; the semantic region regenerated by `gen:migration-registry`).
- `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`: `ui/ObjectMetricProps` gains the site `aggregate` (the count / field refinement does not project into JSON Schema, the same gap `ui/ChartAggregate` records for the chart's identical rule); the site count 659 → 660.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` (`gen:docs`) and `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/ui.md` (`gen:strictness-ledger`: `ui/` 192 → 194 sites, +2 strict).
- `.changeset/21464-component-props-metric-family-typed.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `minor`, BREAKING banner, the `Clause-②` line, the FROM → TO table and the ADR-0087 marker `registered ui-object-metric-aggregate-trend-typed`.

## Measurements

All on `b29eafa062`, the head after merging `origin/main` `36ad3210d4` (which carries #21015's PR, the other edit to `ui/component.zod.ts` and `migrations/registry.ts`; disjoint regions, both sides' entries present after the merge). Heavy runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`; every exit code was written to a file before it was read.

- **`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`**: Test Files 609 passed (609); Tests 18057 passed, 1 todo.
- **`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`**: exit 0; `check:test-typecheck: OK` (52 files / 246 errors / 135 signatures held). `tsconfig.test.json` compiles both pins (`tsc --listFilesOnly`: 2 of 2 named).
- **The two pins**, inside the suite above: 91 tests at the earlier head, unchanged in content since.
- **Ablation** (committed tree, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, inside a script with its own `EXIT INT TERM` restore trap on absolute paths): `trend: ObjectMetricTrendSchema.optional()` → `trend: z.unknown().optional()`, no ledger line. Anchor x1 → x0, blob `a85eb289b7` → `95ff70573c`. Red: Tests 8 failed, 83 passed (91); the enumeration pin's §1 received exactly `[ "object-metric trend" ]`, its census-equals-ledger control read 94 against 93, and the companion pin failed its five `trend` refusals and its member-set case. Restore: blob after restore `a85eb289b7` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty (tool check and trap check both). The pins import `./component.zod` from source, so no build or dist preflight sits between mutation and run. Run at `072d08d8e7`; `component.zod.ts` is byte-identical in its metric region since (the later merge touched `ElementTextPropsSchema` only).
- **Consumer packages** (every package whose fixtures author an `object-metric`, plus the row's one import side): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test` 119 files, 5620 tests passed; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test` 32 files, 399 tests passed; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase validate` (`objectstack validate`): "Validation passed", 0 `component-props` findings over the showcase's thirteen metric tiles; `packages/cli/test/platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts` (its `object-metric` nodes set `title` only): 27 passed. `content/docs` is judged by the derived `check:yaml-examples` below. objectui is read, not run: every value its pinned fixtures author was parsed through this built row (the census), and the arms that parse through `ObjectMetricBlockSchema` all parse.
- **The public door, lit both ways**: the component-props gate (`validateComponentProps` from the built `@objectstack/lint`) on a page with one `object-metric`: the showcase tile and a `count_distinct` tile report nothing; `aggregate: 'count'` reports `component-props-invalid` at `properties.aggregate`; `trend: { direction: 'up' }` reports it at `properties.trend.value`.
- **Derived gates**: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) at `b29eafa062`: 114 commands, 9 paths, 553 changed lines (+536 / -17), under the 5000 threshold. `--ran`: "Run reconciliation — 114 derived, 114 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", exit 0. All 114 exit 0. One run of `pnpm check:type-check-debt` was cut at my own 420 s cap (`exit 124`) and rerun alone: exit 0, "1 ledger entr(ies) re-measured in 100.5s". At the earlier head `072d08d8e7`, `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3, unbuilt packages in a fresh worktree); after building those packages both exit 0, and those lines are kept apart.
- **Changeset gates with this body as the `pull_request` payload**: `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0 — on the corrected body (fix round `48aa1fa253`): "LEVEL AXIS: this PR declares clause-② `yes (narrowing)`" (it first read the original `no (narrowing)` body with the same exit 0: "…, and no package whose `packages/**/src/**` it moves is graded `patch` · direction arm: `narrowing` — a BREAKING change; during the launch window it ships `minor`"); `check-adr-0087-registration` exit 0 (1 declared-breaking changeset, `registered ui-object-metric-aggregate-trend-typed`); `check-empty-changeset` exit 0.
- **`check-widening-tells --declaration no`**: exit 4, six tells — see Acceptance notes. `--declaration yes`: exit 0.
- **Narrowed lint**: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 5 changed TypeScript files: 5 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, at `b29eafa062`. Population from eslint's own `--print-config` (the 5 resolve a config; the changeset, `component.mdx`, the strictness counts page and `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` resolve `undefined`); count from the JSON output; invariance: `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (its own text, lines 326-328), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The full `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- **NOT MEASURED**: the Console Pin Gate, the Dogfood Regression Gate and the full `pnpm lint`, reason: CI-owned. `origin/main` moved four commits after the last merge (to `045b946256`); none touches this PR's 9 paths or anything under `packages/spec`, and none adds a line naming the block, so it was not merged again — the merge queue rebuilds onto current `main`.

## Acceptance notes

- **A published skill teaches a value no door refuses and the tile cannot draw.** `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md:160` (a `kind: 'html'` example) writes `aggregate="count"`. Measured through the html tier's own compile with the committed component manifest (the path `objectstack build` wires): one `warning`, `type-mismatch` ("prop \"aggregate\" expected an object"), and the compiled node carries `aggregate: "count"`; the tile then reads `aggregate.field` and `aggregate.function` as undefined. The same tag with `aggregate={{"function":"count"}}` compiles clean. Reported in the dev report for the seat to file; `skills/**` is a governed surface, so the fix is not a rider here.
- **The client-side aggregate fallback sums a `count_distinct`.** objectui `data-objectstack/src/index.ts:6740-6765` (`aggregateClientSide`) has no `count_distinct` arm, so its `default` sums the field. The tile draws a `count_distinct` correctly wherever the analytics service answers it (`service-analytics` resolves the `_count_distinct` suffix), and a wrong number on a deployment without it. Read-only reading of objectui code, not filed.
- **`check-widening-tells --declaration no` exits 4 on this diff**, six tells: five T1 at the two new schemas' keys inside the former `z.unknown()` bags, and one false T2 at the `dateGranularity` guidance string. The gate's own text rules the T1 shape a true refusal that should declare `yes`; the original claim declared `no (narrowing)`. `--declaration yes` exits 0. Raised in the dev report and **resolved**: the seat re-declared `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` (seat answer `5972917488` on #21464); the re-issued claim, this body's line 2 and the changeset (`48aa1fa253`) all carry it.
